decisions.exactQuestion: Which actual deployment owner/local operator is entitled to initiate the act, and what private capability/channel/lifetime grants that authority?
decisions.nonbindingRecommendation: Recommend same exclusive owner/service under trusted local supervisor; no user token/URL possession/caller boolean as admin authority. Existing close-only IPC and inert prepared configuration remain unchanged until separately reviewed integration.

decisions.exactQuestion: Which concrete stores, backup media/snapshots, process caches, consumer generations and validation captures are controlled, and how is their erasure status established/destruction completed before their further visibility?
decisions.nonbindingRecommendation: Enumerate every actual holder, use a reviewable local cleanup/key lifecycle and a specific consumer acquisition route. No assumption that SQL DELETE makes physical bytes unrecoverable, and no exemption for future raw validation content. Scope cannot waive every-store obligation.

decisions.exactQuestion: Can the supported route require an intact current identity-level store, or must full-store-loss recovery also be supported using independently authoritative latest identity/erasure evidence?
decisions.nonbindingRecommendation: Recommend bounded logical-history import into intact exclusive identity/ledger state first. Do not promise full-store-loss continuity from a copied old DB/configured lineage string. Lost identity guarantee means different Scope URL; unknown erasure content must still be rejected/discarded.
decisions.topic: Supported restore mechanism and continuity anchor

decisions.exactQuestion: What existing trusted policy capture will supply subject-history permission and receiving vs never-observed views on the one final target, without creating a parallel policy language?
decisions.nonbindingRecommendation: Extend the actual private policy implementation only under its existing captured configuration/credential boundary and owned-Link closure. Current all-visible→empty cannot be called the required richer view proof. No credential or secret-committing digest output.

decisions.exactQuestion: How will the changed store format record original served commitments, and what exact refusal/conversion policy applies to existing format11 data with missing original evidence?
decisions.nonbindingRecommendation: Recommend explicit fresh development format/fail-closed old-format refusal for first bounded realization, retaining original data untouched; any conversion is a separate reviewed procedure. Never silently fabricate digests from projected metadata or reseed an existing Scope. This does not authorize production data loss or reset final target.

decisions.exactQuestion: How will permanent lifetime ledger growth, nonempty erasure groups and ledger-first restore fit the unchanged admitted projection/Snapshot/transport limits, and how will serialization escapes be reported out of band without delaying erasure?
decisions.nonbindingRecommendation: Require actual source-derived whole-manifest/group/retained-copy bounds and finite job/activation plan before source release. Snapshot manifest cap is currently10MiB; it is not a lifetime ledger bound. No silent truncation/expiry/ledger paging field/new scheme/cap widening or stopped digest cleanup. Small fixture fit proves only that fixture.

ifDesignNeedsNewProtocol: Stop and state the exact unsupported requirement for Donna/root; do not invent an erasure endpoint/schema/scheme, History expansion, bulk/preview report, weaker cleanup or token rule. No such ruling is selected here.
reason: The selected pinned laws already fix digest domain, administrative no-receipt semantics, same-group live closure, every-store cleanup, view projection/fence, epoch continuity and permanent ledger behavior. Missing realization/assurance is not an undecided wire rule or N/A.
